values.jvm: JDK 25.0.5, G1, UseCountedLoopSafepoints true, LoopStripMiningIter 1000: counted loops keep a safepoint poll every 1000 iterations
values.finding: long time-to-safepoint happens only with the machine saturated, in both builds; the patched build's captures met saturation more often. Baker threads run at Java priority 2 (Windows LOWEST): a baker preempted in Java code by other programs' normal-priority work waits for the scheduler's anti-starvation boost before it reaches its poll, and every other thread, the render thread included, waits at the safepoint.
